Subject: Redwood trial next steps & procurement path

Hi Jared — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment heading into the trial:

1) Success criteria (mutually agreed):
   - 10k generated tokens/day across 3 "pilot" users OR 1k embeddings/day for search use case for 2 consecutive weeks
   - <300ms 95th percentile latency for inference in us-west region
   - No PII leakage on sample prompts (we'll share a short eval set)

2) Trial setup / commercial path options:
   - Card-based / marketplace: fastest path to start (no PO required). Charges begin when you flip billing after trial threshold.
   - PO / paper: acceptable — timeline depends on procurement/legal review. If you need an MSA + SOW we can surface our Redwood-MSA-v2.pdf and the procurement checklist.

3) Ask from Acme for procurement team:
   - Do you prefer PO or card?
   - If PO: primary contact for purchase order + any required contract SLA exceptions
   - Marketplace interest? (AWS/Azure marketplace would let you start via marketplace billing)

4) Tech ask (cc'd Dev & Dylan): please confirm expected model/config for pilot and whether you need data plane in VPC or hosted.

Attachments: Redwood-MSA-v2.pdf, procurement-checklist-acme.xlsx

Proposed next steps:
 - Jared to confirm procurement path & PO contact by Mon 8/17
 - Dev to provide trial key + setup guide once procurement path is clarified
 - Marissa to confirm billing start date tied to success criteria (suggest 2026-09-01 if thresholds met during last week of Aug)

Thanks — looking forward to getting you up and running.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Below are answers from our side: 

- Procurement path: we prefer to go PO for anything over $10k/yr. If the trial will cost us nothing initially and we can convert to card for fast start, that could work, but Procurement will still want the MSA/insurances.
- PO contact: procurement@acmeanalytics.com (cc'd) — procurement lead is Sarah Li. She expects a standard MSA and will flag any deviations.
- Marketplace: we would prefer marketplace billing if it's available on AWS (simpler for our finance team). Please confirm whether Redwood is in AWS Marketplace and whether that route bypasses PO.
- Timeline: legal/procurement review typically 2–3 weeks once they have the MSA.

I've attached our internal procurement checklist that lists required fields for POs and invoice recipients.

Thanks — Jared

jared.kim@acmeanalytics.com | +1 (617) 555-2981

- Trial billing start date: propose 2026-09-01 as the date when conversion billing would start assuming the success criteria above are met in the final trial week. If you need earlier, let me know.

Hi all — quick technical update and confirmations: 

- We can provision a 30-day trial scoped to 3 pilot users with rate limits of 5 requests/sec per user. Keys will be time-limited and scoped to the models you select.
- Default config we recommend for search pilot: open-embedding-medium, and generation model rw-mid-2 quantized; this aligns with the latency target.
- VPC: no mandatory requirement for the pilot; hosted is fine unless you want private networking. If you want VPC, we need a short onboarding window and an IP allowlist.
- Trial-setup-guide.pdf attached — includes steps to run the sample eval and the success criteria checks (token counts, latency tests).

Billing start date suggestion: 2026-09-01, conditional on hitting the success thresholds the final week of the trial. If procurement confirms PO route and cannot accept marketplace billing, let us know PO timing and we'll align SOW execution accordingly.

Regards,
